replies.author: OmniDom
replies.body:
I really enjoy maps with a lot of iron and 26 diamonds or so that can be mined throughout the entire map. (Not including chest diamonds) This makes it possible for a team to obtain full diamond gear just from the mines. I'm also a fan of potions and an interesting landscape. The middle should be harder to get to (traps, parkour), and have a juicier reward to make it desirable. Another feature that I believe is widely enjoyed is the chests. I dislike the chests that are buried under dirt and stuff, where it's near impossible to discover without a blockfinder "mod", or playing the map hundreds of times. It's great when large structures have hidden chests, such as that new map with the castle (If anyone knows the name, please comment it)
Thanks for reading this!

replies.author: NutMeggs
replies.body: Drake I see lots of people like the op maps but ik a lot of other people (including me) like the maps without the strength, full dia, and other unfair advantages. Strength takes away from the concept of walls being a pvp based game, it just shows who can hit the other person first. And full diamond usually only allows for one player per team to get it which would be unfair to the other teammates and would make gameplay unfair. I prefer maps with fewer diamonds, not too many potions, nice gameplay, and NO strength

replies.author: Drakeyy
replies.body:
From what we have done right now, there is quite a few easy to find dias. I'm going to estimate there's probably around 100 per quarter. I am building it with a player who isn't very experienced on walls servers so she's giving opinions on what she likes on maps as well as my opinions.

We aren't putting any strength pots on the map. However, there is one way you can get a blaze rod as of right now, but it requires you trade in a lot of valuable things. So we shall see what happens there.

The theme of our map would probably be something like Maze Runner in a way. You're dropped into this building and you have to survive on your own. You'll see :)

Lot's of rooms, a few traps, lots of secret passageways and loads of chests. Food is easy to find. Resources are easy to find, and there's plenty so that it's not one player with everything.

replies.author: Murphh
replies.body:
Love the idea of Maze Runner theme! 
Village is still my favorite map because I like the amount of diamonds, iron, and food.  Few potions.  No strength. There are options on where to "hide" or ambush other players.  I like the size of this map too (not too big).  Plus, it's just visually appealing to me. 

Traps are okay or even just the items available to make traps.
